name: TheHive
description: Collaborative security incident response platform for triaging alerts and running investigation cases.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CQL_HOSTNAMES: "{{serviceName}}-cassandra"
      INDEX_HOSTNAMES: "{{serviceName}}-elasticsearch"
      JVM_OPTS: {{env.JVM_OPTS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/opt/thp/thehive/data
      - {{appDataPath}}/index:/opt/thp/thehive/index
  {{serviceName}}-cassandra:
    image: cassandra:4.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-cassandra
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CASSANDRA_CLUSTER_NAME: thehive
  {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:7.17.24
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: false
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms1g -Xmx1g"
